Name: Aholibamah
Summary: Aholibamah was a wife of Esau, the daughter of Anah, and the mother of Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.
KeyStory: Aholibamah's sons became dukes in Edom, and her name is also borne by a later Edomite chief.
RelatedPeople: Esau; Anah; Jeush; Jaalam; Korah, Son of Esau
LifeLesson: God names women in genealogies where the world might forget them.
